import.title: Import your profile
import.lead: Start from what you already have. You review everything before it’s saved, and the file itself isn’t kept.

linkedin_zip.title: Your LinkedIn data export
linkedin_zip.description: The ZIP LinkedIn sends you from Settings, Data privacy, Get a copy of your data. Read here, without AI.

pdf.title: A PDF
pdf.description: Your CV, or your LinkedIn profile saved as a PDF. An AI model reads it.

text.title: Pasted text
text.description: Your CV or your profile, copied as text. An AI model reads it.

import.zipOnly: Ask LinkedIn for a copy of your data (Settings, Data privacy), then upload the ZIP it sends you. PDFs and pasted text need an AI model, which this Applicamp hasn’t set up.
import.zipHint: Up to 20 MB. Only your profile, positions, education, skills, languages, certifications, projects and main email are read.
import.pdfHint: Up to 8 MB and 30 pages, with real text (not a scan).
import.textLabel: Your CV or profile, as text

review.title: Review what was found
review.lead: Nothing is saved until you choose. Replace makes this your profile; Merge keeps yours as it is and adds only what’s new.
review.gone: This draft is no longer here: drafts last 24 hours.
review.droppedBody: They weren’t in the file, so we didn’t keep them. Nothing is ever made up.

strength.title: Profile strength
strength.description: Agents only use what is written here, and every line in a CV traces back to it. A stronger profile means better matches and better CVs.
strength.strong: Strong. Keep it up to date.
strength.reading: The AI is reading your profile for what is missing…
strength.checklist: What your profile strength is made of
strength.note: Strength is what agents can use: a headline and summary, results on your recent roles, skills, education, languages, a link, your positions and your goals. It never counts what you would rather leave out.

summary.missing: Three or four sentences about what you do best

grill.title: Grill me
grill.lead: A CV can only say what Applicamp knows. Pick a role and answer one question at a time. Vague answers get pushed back on and numbers get asked about. Every fact taken from your answers is shown to you first; nothing is saved until you keep it.
grill.roleLoadFailed: This role’s interview couldn’t be loaded.
grill.noRolesTitle: No roles to talk about yet
grill.noRolesLead: Import or write your profile first. Grill me goes through one role at a time.
grill.pickLead: A role takes about a dozen questions. Each one is a single small AI call, about €0.001, and nothing runs until you click.
grill.startLead: It starts with one question about this role. Answer in your own words; it asks again if it needs more.
grill.coveredBanner: All seven areas are covered for this role.
grill.coveredLead: Your kept facts are under this role on your profile. Come back to add more.
grill.stoppedBanner: Nothing left to ask for now.
grill.doneNote: Left for now. Start again any time and it carries on from here.
grill.answerHint: Enter sends it; Shift and Enter start a new line.
grill.answerPlaceholder: Answer in your own words. Rough is fine; it asks again if it needs more.
grill.done: Done with this role for now
grill.costLine: Each question is one small AI call, about €0.001. Questions today: {{n}} of {{cap}}.
